title: How to ACE the Initial Interview
description:
Are you getting interviews but never getting callbacks for a second? The problem is most likely the way you are answering some of the questions. Most interviews are decided within the first 10 minutes with the biggest culprit question being “Tell me about yourself.” So here’s how to answer it… #jobinterview #jobinterviewtips #jobsearchtips
